description: Record what you found: traffic light, priority, a short comment, and context_doc - the markdown file holding the longer story, so the next seat picking up a stale lane reads it instead of starting cold. Absent fields are left untouched, so updating one never blanks another seat's note. Leave light alone rather than saying green about something you did not check.

context_doc.description: Path or filename of the markdown holding the longer story. Empty string clears it.

name: update_lane
title: Update an Operations lane
